newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Yageo Jan-April sales up 30 pct yr/yr.
newsitem.headline: Yageo Jan-April sales up 30 pct yr/yr.

text.p: Taiwan's leading resistor maker Yageo Corp said on Friday its January-April sales rose 30 percent to T$830 million from T$641 million in the same period a year earlier.
In April, its sales hit a monthly record of T$235 million, up 32 percent from T$178 million in April 1996, Yageo said in a statement.
It said its global group sales of resistors had reached T$1.7 billion in the first four months, and it expected its sales to continue growing in the rest of 1997.
